messages:
maya: Morning — heads up, SDK PR #432 (https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/432) is waiting on console API change in console repo. If console team can merge today we can avoid a revert window. Can someone from console + runtime give an ETA? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: @maya I'll pick this up. Looking at console PR #1287 now, main blocker is schema rename in api types.
sara: I left a review on #1287 with a small suggestion to keep backward compat. If we can get a patch to typings we can unbreak SDK.
tom: FYI helm chart needs a values bump too — I opened a tiny PR in helm/charts#56 but it depends on runtime image tag from runtime PR #212.
maya: OK — so merge order: console #1287 -> runtime #212 -> helm#56 -> sdk#432. Does that sound right?
kevin: yes. I'll try to land console #1287 within the hour. Re-running CI now: `./ci/run_checks.sh`.
jen: If CI flakes, please @me. Can approve console changes once CI is green.
alex: I can hold the runtime merge slot at 15:30 PT. If console lands before then I'll merge runtime immediately and cut image.
sara: tagging owners: @jen @alex — can y'all confirm merge windows?
jen: confirm. 15:30 PT works for me.
deploy-bot: [auto] CI succesful for console#1287 — all checks passed. :white_check_mark:
kevin: landed console#1287. tagging @alex for runtime.
alex: merging runtime#212 now, will push image `gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-17-15-31`.
deploy-bot: [auto] runtime image build succeeded -> gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-17-15-31
alex: helm#56 merged and released to staging.
sara: SDK#432 green now, rebase + merging. Thanks everyone :tada:
maya: Amazing — can someone drop a short note in release-notes channel after prod cut? I want to track customer impact.
jen: will do.
kevin: quick retrospective: we should add a cross-repo checklist to PR descriptions for these stacks. I'll draft one after lunch.
maya: thanks — closing loop. :wave:
